All databases are set Soil results has general soil analyses Infiltration and comaction database as only infiltraion analyses which include subquadrat measures

Bayesian model

Bayesian model specifications

# Bayesian models specifications ---------------------------------------------------------
# Define options for the NUTS sampler
nchains <- 4    # number of chains (at least 4 for NUTS sampling)
niter <- 10000   # number of iterations per chain
nwarm <- 5000   # number of iterations to warm up before sampling 
#4 x (10000-5000)= 20000 iterations

Models dry 10-20

pH Log model dry 10-20

#pHlog model
fitGLMM1_D <- brm(pHlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM1_D)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: pHlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 101) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.97      0.31     0.55     1.72 1.00     7044    10401
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                                 0.15      0.62    -1.10     1.37 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP                          0.18      0.28    -0.37     0.73 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                           -0.43      0.88    -2.18     1.33 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous                     -0.38      0.87    -2.10     1.36 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                        0.22      0.87    -1.52     1.94 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid           0.07      0.41    -0.74     0.86 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous     0.21      0.39    -0.55     0.97 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      -0.90      0.40    -1.69    -0.11 1.00
##                                       Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                                10473     9977
## PD.disturbanceWP                         15112    13414
## Grass.typeArid                           10621    10396
## Grass.typeCalcareous                     10923     9722
## Grass.typeMountain                       10738    10286
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid          16698    15266
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous    16559    15001
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      16749    14813
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.70      0.05     0.60     0.81 1.00    17718    14562
## 
## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
fitGLMM1_D$prior
##                    prior     class                                  coef group
##                   (flat)         b                                            
##                   (flat)         b                        Grass.typeArid      
##                   (flat)         b                  Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                   (flat)         b                    Grass.typeMountain      
##                   (flat)         b                      PD.disturbanceWP      
##                   (flat)         b       PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid      
##                   (flat)         b PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                   (flat)         b   PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      
##  student_t(3, -0.1, 2.5) Intercept                                            
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                            
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                          ID
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                             Intercept    ID
##     student_t(3, 0, 2.5)     sigma                                            
##  resp dpar nlpar lb ub       source
##                             default
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                             default
##                   0         default
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0         default
pHlog1_D1<-fitGLMM1_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "pH scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
pHlog1_D1

#obtaining HPD (HIGHEST POSTERIOR DENSITY)

emmeansph3<-emmeans(fitGLMM1_D,pairwise~PD.disturbance:Grass.type, adjust="tukey")

#conductivity log model 
fitGLMM2_D <- brm(conductivitylog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM2_D)

condlog1_D2<-fitGLMM2_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Conductivity scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
condlog1_D2

#K log model 

fitGLMM4_D <- brm(Klog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM4_D)

#Mg log model 

fitGLMM5_D <- brm(Mglog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM5_D)

##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity

##          total post-warmup draws = 20000

Mglog1_D2<-fitGLMM5_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Mg scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
  Mglog1_D2

##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: Nalog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 101) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     1.11      0.34     0.65     1.95 1.00     6507     9915
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                                -0.12      0.68    -1.49     1.23 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP                          0.38      0.22    -0.05     0.81 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                           -0.00      0.97    -1.94     1.92 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous                     -0.18      0.98    -2.11     1.79 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                        0.95      0.97    -1.01     2.89 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid          -0.54      0.31    -1.15     0.07 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous    -0.47      0.30    -1.06     0.12 1.00
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      -0.87      0.31    -1.47    -0.26 1.00
##                                       Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                                10836    10730
## PD.disturbanceWP                         13931    13294
## Grass.typeArid                           11284    11977
## Grass.typeCalcareous                     10847    10329
## Grass.typeMountain                       10948    11380
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid          16463    14534
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous    16326    14835
## PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      16548    14646
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.54      0.04     0.46     0.63 1.00    19183    15060
## 
## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
fitGLMM6_D$prior
##                   prior     class                                  coef group
##                  (flat)         b                                            
##                  (flat)         b                        Grass.typeArid      
##                  (flat)         b                  Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                  (flat)         b                    Grass.typeMountain      
##                  (flat)         b                      PD.disturbanceWP      
##                  (flat)         b       PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeArid      
##                  (flat)         b PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeCalcareous      
##                  (flat)         b   PD.disturbanceWP:Grass.typeMountain      
##  student_t(3, 0.1, 2.5) Intercept                                            
##    student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                            
##    student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                                          ID
##    student_t(3, 0, 2.5)        sd                             Intercept    ID
##    student_t(3, 0, 2.5)     sigma                                            
##  resp dpar nlpar lb ub       source
##                             default
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                        (vectorized)
##                             default
##                   0         default
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0    (vectorized)
##                   0         default
Nalog1_D2<-fitGLMM6_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Na scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
Nalog1_D2

#P log model #has two divergences
fitGLMM7_D <- brm(P.TUDlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM7_D)

#Corg log model 
fitGLMM8_D <- brm(Corglog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Warning: Rows containing NAs were excluded from the model.
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM8_D)

Corglog1_D2<-fitGLMM8_D %>%
  emmeans( ~ PD.disturbance | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PD.disturbance, y = .value)) + labs( y = "C. Org scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
Corglog1_D2

#TN log model 
fitGLMM9_D <- brm(TNlog ~ PD.disturbance + Grass.type + PD.disturbance:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Warning: Rows containing NAs were excluded from the model.
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM9_D)
